task.title: Rewrite a weak product page for an online saree store
task.brief: Below is a draft product description for an online saree store. It is long, vague and has grammar mistakes. Rewrite it in 15 to 20 minutes. A good answer: a clear title, a short opening line that says what the saree is and who it suits, 4 to 6 short bullet points with the real details (fabric, size, care, price), and one clear call to action. Fix all grammar errors. Do not invent facts that are not in the draft. Aim for 120 to 180 words.
task.material:
DRAFT:

BEST SAREE EVER!!! This saree is very very beautiful and it is having a very rich look which will make you look like a queen in all the functions and also wedding's. The fabric is a pure Kanchipuram silk and the colour is maroon with golden zari border it is 5.5 meters and blouse piece of 0.8 meter is also coming with it. Kindly note dry clean only is recommended else colour may go. We are giving free shipping all over India. Price is Rs 8,499 only including GST. Hurry up and do the needful and buy it before stock finish because these kind of sarees are not available anywhere in market. Return is accepted in 7 days if tag is not removed.
key_points: Keeps all real facts: Kanchipuram silk, maroon, golden zari border, 5.5 m saree, 0.8 m blouse piece
Keeps price ₹8,499 incl. GST, free shipping in India, 7-day return with tag on, dry clean only
Removes hype and false claims like 'not available anywhere'
Fixes grammar ('is having', 'wedding's', 'is also coming', 'stock finish', 'do the needful')
Uses a clear title, short intro and bullet points
Ends with one clear call to action
Does not add facts that were not in the draft

rubric.label: Grammar and facts
rubric.guide: 0 = many errors or facts changed, 3 = few small errors, 5 = error-free and every fact kept accurately

rubric.label: Clarity and structure
rubric.guide: 0 = still one long block, 3 = some structure, 5 = title, short intro, clean bullets, easy to scan

rubric.label: Tone
rubric.guide: 0 = pushy or hyped like the draft, 3 = neutral but flat, 5 = warm, confident and honest, suits the buyer

rubric.label: Completeness
rubric.guide: 0 = key details missing, 3 = most details, 5 = all buyer details plus a clear call to action
